title: Task params for oedis.handler.smb.download
description: Configuration for downloading files from an SMB share into the task inbox.

connection.description: SMB connection settings used to resolve the UNC share root and optional credentials.

unc.description: UNC root path for the SMB share, for example \\FS01\FinanceShare or \\FS01\FinanceShare\Inbound\CORRA.

auth.description: Optional SMB credentials passed to register_session().

requests.description: List of SMB download instructions. Each item describes one remote source selection and how matched files should be copied into the inbox.

src_dir.description: Remote source directory relative to connection.unc. Leave empty to discover files from the UNC root. Accepts either backslashes or forward slashes.

dst_dir.description: Destination directory under ctx.inbox. Must be a relative local path when provided.

include.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to include. Matching is attempted against both the file name and the path relative to src_dir. Prefer recursive=true with patterns like '*.csv' instead of '**/*.csv'.

exclude.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to exclude after include matching. Matching is attempted against both the file name and the path relative to src_dir.

recursive.description: When true, walk subdirectories under src_dir. When false, only files directly under src_dir are considered.

updated_after.description: Optional inclusive lower bound for SMB file modified time. Accepts the datetime string formats supported by the handler.

updated_before.description: Optional exclusive upper bound for SMB file modified time. Accepts the datetime string formats supported by the handler.

delete_source_file.description: When true, delete the remote SMB file after a successful download and local size validation.
